items.source: This is particularly useful for delegating to existing data access code that expects a ReactiveRedisConnection to work on. For newly written code, it is strongly recommended to use ReactiveRedisOperations's more specific operations.
items.translation: 这对于将任务委托给现有的数据访问代码非常有用，这些代码期望在 ReactiveRedisConnection 接口上工作。对于新编写的代码，强烈建议使用 ReactiveRedisOperations 提供的更具体的操作。

items.source:
Allows for returning a result object created within the callback, i.e. a domain object or a collection of domain
objects.
items.translation: 允许返回在回调中创建的结果对象，即一个领域对象或一组领域对象。

items.source: Gets called by ReactiveRedisTemplate.execute(ReactiveRedisCallback) with an active Redis connection.
items.translation: 由ReactiveRedisTemplate.execute(ReactiveRedisCallback)调用，此时已建立活跃的 Redis 连接。

items.source: DataAccessException - in case of custom exceptions
items.translation: DataAccessException - 针对自定义异常的情况

items.source: Generic callback interface for code that operates on a low-level ReactiveRedisConnection. Allows to execute any number of operations on a single ReactiveRedisConnection, using any type and number of commands.
items.translation: 用于在底层ReactiveRedisConnection上执行操作的通用回调接口。允许使用任意类型和数量的命令，对单个ReactiveRedisConnection执行任意数量的操作。

items.source: Gets called by ReactiveRedisTemplate.execute(ReactiveRedisCallback) with an active Redis connection. Does not need to care about activating or closing the ReactiveRedisConnection.
items.translation: 由ReactiveRedisTemplate.execute(ReactiveRedisCallback)调用，此时已拥有活跃的 Redis 连接。无需关心激活或关闭ReactiveRedisConnection。
